notes:
The Spanish dictionary also knows the pronoun forms of common verbs: «ocultarle», «negarle», «deberle», «decírmelo» and thousands like them are no longer underlined.

The compile dialog is now fully in Spanish in the Spanish interface: section types, the layout preview and its sample text, the token buttons, and the suggested file name («manuscrito»).

Turning grammar checking on now underlines the open document straight away, and turning it off clears the underlines. Before, nothing changed until you reopened the document. Grammar also checks the page as soon as LanguageTool finishes starting.

The Spanish spelling dictionary is updated to RLA-ES 2.9, so words like «murete», «ocultamiento» and «rascarlo» are no longer underlined. Settings now gives its licence correctly.

In the Spanish interface the compile layouts of the built-in formats are called «Escena» and «Capítulo» instead of Scene and Chapter. Names you gave your own layouts stay as you wrote them.
